question: For every one of the 54 eight-edge same-first-flux L=2 private errors, does the complete action-conditioned second full-binary public record differ from the fixed base error after the selected all-plus first public record?
claim_boundary: Exact conditional law matrix on all 54 J8C eight-edge supports versus base, one ideal L=2 orbit, one selected first record, two fixed public actions. Neither first-record selection probability nor the full physical error prior is integrated into information/risk. No other first records, full-IID information, logical risk, noisy JIT, L=3, crossing or threshold.

integrity_amendment.reason: The first attempt produced all candidate laws but its direct-moment spot-check loop executed zero checks because the first eligible site was not an admissible check. The complete-law comparison is withheld pending an actual per-cell direct check; no scientific or resource scope changed.
integrity_amendment.replacement_gate: Require one admissible signed-product versus direct-moment identity check in every one of the 110 action cells; fail closed otherwise. Save the replacement separately and use only it for analysis/reporting.

matrix.candidate_source: All 54 distinct J8C eight-edge private errors, 18 in each registered winding class; no result-dependent selection or ordering change
matrix.observation_timing: Ideal first full-binary public record is selected before the relation-free red-charge action; the second full-binary public flux/charge/vacuum record is action-bound. The hidden red-X error and projector/orbit state are private generation variables only.
matrix.calculation: For each private error and fixed action, solve exact signed first-projector affine classes for all 22 eligible second-site singleton means and every parity group among at most five variable second sites. Invert the complete Walsh moment vector to normalized nonnegative 24-site public charge rows, with flux and vacuum encoded by the frozen public_record convention. Compare each candidate law with the matched base law under the same first public record and action using exact total variation.
matrix.independent_unit: One exact private-error/selected-first-record/fixed-action law cell; no stochastic sample, interval or bootstrap
matrix.integrity: Hash-pin all source/result inputs and runner before/after; require 54 unique candidate supports and base, exactly 18 candidates per winding class, exact positive first masses, identical first public flux, action-bound second flux, 22 eligible sites, prior J8F/J8H variable-site replay, J8G affine-size replay, every row public and normalized, eight J8D old-law exact replays, direct moment checks, no hidden error in public record, and zero histories/arms/bootstraps. Any mismatch fails closed.

acceptance: All 54 candidates and base have both fixed-action complete second full-binary laws after the same selected first public record, or report an exact cap-censored prefix without a class-wide inference
Every conditional law is nonnegative and sums to one, with action-bound flux, charge/vacuum public convention, positive first mass and first/second site gates
All eight earlier base/representative full laws replay exactly; one independent direct moment passes in each of 110 action cells; aggregate signed plus direct work and CPU stay within inherited caps
Compute exact total variation of each of 108 candidate/action laws against its matched base law, retaining any difference rather than assuming equality
Report only this selected-first-record ideal L=2 support-class conclusion; do not promote to full-IID information, unconditional/logical risk, noisy JIT, L=3 or threshold
stop_rule: Stop at 54 candidate supports plus base and 110 action-law cells, first inherited CPU/term cap, or immediately on any source hash, public-interface, positivity, normalization, direct-moment or old-law replay failure. Do not adapt the support set or budget to observed results.
